class.name: OcgGceMakecone
class.brief_description: This class implements construction algorithms for `gp_Cone`. Supported constructions include: - from axis placement, semi-angle and reference radius; - cone coaxial to another cone, through a point or at signed offset; - cone from four points; - cone from axis and two points; - cone from two axis points and two section radii.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Creates a cone coaxial to input cone and passing through a point.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a cone coaxial to input cone at signed distance.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates a cone from axis placement, semi-angle and reference radius.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Creates a cone from axis and two points.

method.name: from_5
method.description: Creates a cone from line axis and two points.

method.name: from_6
method.description: Creates a cone from four points.

method.name: from_7
method.description: Creates a cone from two axis points and two section radii.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the constructed cone. Exceptions StdFail_NotDone if no cone is constructed.

method.name: Operator
method.description: Alias for Value() returning a copy.
